text: Can create and run a first trace in under 5 minutes
quote: Create and run your first trace in less than 5 minutes.

text: Run experiments to evaluate prompts, models, and app code against chosen metrics
quote: Experiments allow you to evaluate prompts, models, and your application code, using well-defined inputs, against metrics of your choice.

text: UI provides a 'Create Experiment' button to add experiments to a project
quote: In the Galileo console UI, "Create Experiment" buttons allow you to easily add experiments to a project.

text: MCP integration lets you create/manage datasets, run experiments, and set up prompt templates from your dev environment
quote: With MCP, you can access Galileo's capabilities directly from your development environment, including: Creating and managing datasets, Running experiments, Setting up prompt templates

text: Provides agentic metrics to measure multi-step agent task performance, tool use, and decision-making
quote: Agentic metrics help you measure how well your AI agents perform complex, multi-step tasks—especially when those agents need to use tools, make decisions, or interact with external systems.

text: Captures every session, trace, and span as structured real-time data once instrumented
quote: Once instrumented, Galileo captures every session, trace, and span, producing a structured stream of real-time data.

text: Joins spans sharing a trace ID via OpenTelemetry's W3C traceparent header into a single trace
quote: OpenTelemetry's W3C `traceparent` header carries the trace context across the wire. Galileo joins all spans that share a trace ID into a single trace.

text: Lets you extend metrics with custom LLM-as-judge or code-based scorers
quote: You can then expand these metrics with custom metrics, using LLM-as-a-judge, or custom code-based metrics.

text: Sends alerts when unexpected events occur
quote: Galileo enables you to get alerted whenever unexpected things happen.

text: Accepts natural-language feedback that continuously refines metrics to match your domain
quote: This allows you to continuously provide feedback in natural language that automatically improves the metrics to align better with your domain, or expected inputs and outputs.

text: Provides an @log decorator to log spans in code
quote: You can also use the `@log` decorator to log spans.

text: Builds datasets from synthetic, development, and live production data
quote: Build your datasets from synthetic, development, and live production data. Capture subject matter expert annotations to create a living asset that continuously grounds your AI systems.
